gloss: Matsuba crab; San'in brand-name snow crab

definitions.gloss: Matsuba crab; San'in brand-name snow crab
definitions.explanation: A regional brand name for male snow crab landed in the San'in region, mainly at ports in Tottori Prefecture. Biologically the same species as other regional snow-crab brands; the name marks where the crab is caught, not a different kind of crab.

examples.japanese: {松葉|まつば}{蟹|がに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{鳥取|とっとり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{松葉|まつば}{蟹|がに}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Tottori is famous for matsuba crab.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧になると、{松葉|まつば}{蟹|がに}⟦{目当|めあ}て→目当て：13648_meate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{山陰|さんいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: When winter comes, more people travel to the San'in region specifically for matsuba crab.

notes:
{松葉|まつば}{蟹|がに} is the brand name given to male snow crab landed at ports in the San'in region, especially {鳥取|とっとり}⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧.

USAGE:
The crab itself is the same species sold elsewhere as {越前|えちぜん}{蟹|がに} (landed in Fukui) or under other regional names; the brand reflects the landing port and local quality standards, not a separate species.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {松葉|まつば}{蟹|がに}{漁|りょう}: matsuba crab fishing
- {松葉|まつば}{蟹|がに}⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: matsuba crab hot pot
- {松葉|まつば}{蟹|がに}{丼|どん}: matsuba crab rice bowl

CULTURAL NOTE:
{鳥取|とっとり}⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ promotes {松葉|まつば}{蟹|がに} as a signature winter delicacy and tourist draw. The fishing season opens each November, and many ryokan in the region offer crab-centered courses through the winter.
